title: AWS IAM (terraform-aws-modules/iam/aws)
description: Provision an IAM role with an optional inline policy and attached managed policies via ACK iam. Input names mirror the terraform-aws-modules/iam/aws module (iam-role / iam-assumable-role submodules, core subset of its inputs).

region.title: AWS region
region.description: AWS region for the IAM resources. Krateo/ACK wiring (not a Terraform module input). IAM is a global service; this only sets the services.k8s.aws/region annotation used by the ACK controller. Empty inherits the ACK controller default.

create.title: create
create.description: Controls if resources should be created (affects all resources).

name.title: name
name.description: Name to use on IAM role created.

max_session_duration.title: max_session_duration
max_session_duration.description: Maximum session duration (in seconds) that you want to set for the specified role. If you do not specify a value for this setting, the default maximum of one hour is applied. This setting can have a value from 1 hour (3600) to 12 hours (43200).

permissions_boundary.title: permissions_boundary
permissions_boundary.description: ARN of the policy that is used to set the permissions boundary for the IAM role.

assume_role_policy.title: assume_role_policy
assume_role_policy.description: The trust relationship policy document as a JSON-formatted string. Maps to the ACK Role.spec.assumeRolePolicyDocument. If empty, a trust policy is generated from trusted_role_services.

trusted_role_services.title: trusted_role_services
trusted_role_services.description: AWS Services that can assume this role (e.g. ec2.amazonaws.com). Used to generate a sts:AssumeRole trust policy when assume_role_policy is not provided.

managed_policy_arns.title: managed_policy_arns
managed_policy_arns.description: List of ARNs of IAM managed policies to attach to the role. These must reference EXISTING managed policies and are passed through to ACK Role.spec.policies.

create_inline_policy.title: create_inline_policy
create_inline_policy.description: Determines whether to create a customer-managed IAM policy from inline_policy and attach it to the role (rendered as a separate ACK Policy wired via policyRefs).

inline_policy.title: inline_policy
inline_policy.description: The JSON-formatted permissions policy document for the customer-managed policy created when create_inline_policy is true. Maps to ACK Policy.spec.policyDocument.

tags.title: tags
tags.description: A map of tags to add to all resources.
